root_cause.text: The work item `dump_work` is not canceled before the `crash_data` structure is freed in the device removal path, allowing a concurrent execution of `mt7915_mac_dump_work()` to access already deallocated memory.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message detail the race: CPU 0 (removal) calls `mt7915_coredump_unregister()` which does `vfree(dev->coredump.crash_data)`, while CPU 1 (workqueue) queues and executes `dump_work` which dereferences `crash_data` after its free. The fix adds `cancel_work_sync(&dev->dump_work)` before `mt7915_coredump_unregister()` in `mt7915_unregister_device()`.
